scope: I09 individual ATR-normalized one-bar movement and signed efficiency, separate branches; no combination/live/ladder changes.
formula: ATR14 Wilder TR from bar1 using prior close, mean seed first14 changes then (previous*13+TR)/14. Signed ATR move=(close[t]-close[t-1])/ATR14[t-1]; current shock never in its own denominator. First valid index15; prior zero ATR invalid/null. ER_N=abs(close[t]-close[t-N])/sum(abs(close[j]-close[j-1]),j=t-N+1..t), signed ER uses signed numerator; first indexN; flat travel=>ER0, not missing; current-inclusive N changes, no rounding/clamping/reseed/gap bridge. Signed ER adds direction explicitly, ordinary ER and ATR unsigned. KAMA not implemented.
entryRules: Let v=entry-side sign*selected signed metric. trend: previous<=threshold,current>threshold; into: previous>=-threshold,current<-threshold; recovery: previous<=-threshold,current>-threshold. Fresh crossings only, not sustained levels. Recovery is metric retreat, not guaranteed price reversal.
exitRules: 12h from actual fill, or earliest subsequent selected metric zero condition capped12h: trend signed<=0, into/recovery signed>=0. Timeout wins ties, no entry-observation exit, pending immutable; occupied crossings skipped, not queued; no inferred intrabar threshold fills.
timing: Contiguous finalized selected-timeframe bars; next minute-open, modeled0 publication lag or separate+1m every entry and exit. Full fixed seed; no execution-minute H/L/C at decision, no future bar or sliding reseed.
inventory: One independent $10k position; no compounding/averaging. Occupied/pending crossings skipped, fresh signal after exit. Open cutoff inventory marked including hypothetical close fee; not counted as completed.
funding: Excluded due incomplete settlement evidence. After trading fees before funding; no liquidation/shared-account/queue/live fills certification.
researchScreen: Same inherited screen: >=30full/10recent closes in both delays, positive net and own-side clock delta allfour; no monthly marked delta below-1e-8; positive extra5bps/side and no equity exhaustion.
ranking: All720 by full0m delta to own-side clock; additionally each family by absolute full0m net among sample/net/cost/solvent allfour. Overall top5 and top5 per branch plus rawtop5 retained with all monthly/clock failures. These are descriptive, no relaxed live gate.
reporting: Baseline full/recent W/L and dollars, open/net/DD, monthly top5 overall and per branch plus rawtop5, both action delays and cost stress, optional-exit own fixed12h deltas, paths/concentration and all720 IDs. Existing rolling12h controls remain exact; no claim this standalone baseline equals ladder sim-exact.
limitations: Previously mined, overlapping windows and720 correlated definitions. No ATR/ER mix, RSI/MACD/ADX/HL/SR mix, KAMA, ATR trailing/stops/TPs/risk sizing or ladder/filter application. ATR smoothing periods other than14 and multibar normalized displacement not tested; ER other lengths/thresholds, unsigned-only conditioning and persistent-state gates not tested. Funding, arrival, shared margin, liquidation and actual executions unverified.
